subject: How to show/hide plots with Shiny/javascript

messages.subject: How to show/hide plots with Shiny/javascript
parts:
Hi

I have some questions of using javascript and Shiny. If we look at the example:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/nvd3-line-chart-output.html
then can show/hide the graphs by clicking on the legends. How do you set an initial setting? If you want one of the graphs to be hidden initially, for example? 

Additional example: I also have auto-update using 
autoInvalidate <- reactiveTimer(5000, session)

But then how do you make Shiny remember what plots were shown last? If you just run autoInvalidate() then it will go back to showing all graphs and not just the ones I have selected to be shown by clicking the legends.

Thanks for any inputs :)

Ben
